title: Run USEARCH for Quality Control of a 16S RNA Dataset
author: Alise J Ponsero
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.s8iehue

steps.title: Generate Quality Control Summary
steps.instruction: Use the USEARCH -fastx_info command to generate a summary of length distribution and quality for the FASTQ reads.

substeps.instruction: Open a shell and create a results directory: DIR=$PWD mkdir fastq_info
Run quality info for the R1 file: FILE1='$DIR/16S-mockS.1_V4_R1-hdr.fastq' OUT1='$DIR/fastq_info/16S-mockS.1_V4_R1-hdr.log' ./usearch -fastx_info $FILE1 -output $OUT1
Run quality info for the R2 file: FILE2='$DIR/16S-mockS.1_V4_R2-hdr.fastq' OUT2='$DIR/fastq_info/16S-mockS.1_V4_R2-hdr.log' ./usearch -fastx_info $FILE2 -output $OUT2

steps.title: Filter and Convert FASTQ to FASTA
steps.instruction: Use the -fastq_filter command to perform quality filtering and convert the FASTQ files to FASTA format.

substeps.instruction: For simple conversion without filtering, run: ./usearch -fastq_filter 16S-mockS.1_V4_R1-hdr.fastq -fastaout 16S-mockS.1_V4_R1-hdr.fasta

To truncate reads to length 150 and discard reads with expected errors > 0.5, run: ./usearch -fastq_filter 16S-mockS.1_V4_R1-hdr.fastq -fastq_trunclen 150 -fastq_maxee 0.5 -fastaout 16S-mockS.1_V4_R1-hdr.fasta
Repeat the filtering process for the R2 file: ./usearch -fastq_filter 16S-mockS.1_V4_R2-hdr.fastq -fastq_trunclen 150 -fastq_maxee 0.5 -fastaout 16S-mockS.1_V4_R2-hdr.fasta
